prefix.start: present regular ledger; full stable raw length N0 and hash H0 with complete LF framing; original rows must parse as unique-ID objects for collision checks; historical row classes preserved opaque, never grandfathered as allowed new classes
prefix.each_capture: same dev/ino; N_i>=N_prev>=N0; SHA256(bytes[0:N0])==H0 AND SHA256(bytes[0:N_prev])==H_prev; raw full hash/length stored each time; all suffix rows satisfy new closed schema
prefix.privacy: future validator processes private prefix in memory only, publishes capture IDs/hash/length/count/result not rows; this review does not read shared ledger
prefix.limitation: endpoint/prefix hashes plus inotify cannot prove absence of unseen overwrite-and-restore or truncate-and-regrow; proposal accepts only bounded observed-prefix integrity if Owner expressly accepts this limitation; full syscall-history requirement cannot be met by current observer

allowed: st_size nondecreasing and exact captured byte length
st_mtime_ns/st_ctime_ns nondecreasing, only attached to a validated growth batch; unchanged bytes require all nine original fields equal

events.target: only exact ledger object with bound identity
events.combinations: reject combined masks and all other masks; no masking off unknown bits

events.completion: retain every event; drain fully before boundary; no unresolved write/partial record/pending event crosses a command/gate boundary; multiple modifies/closes allowed within finite limits, not paired to writer

At each preflight/prestart/gate/command boundary, stable actual capture, both original and previous prefix verification, full suffix parse and strict-input independent comparison; no deferred incomplete rows
Reader/source/policy identity change or dynamic reader unbound => reject; never use later recapture to rewrite an earlier failed comparison
end: Final stable capture and drain under uninterrupted coverage; no post-capture unexplained event; all pending resolved and strict inputs complete
Seal capture IDs, observed events, prefix hashes, appended counts, policy+source+qualification binding, native exits and exact reject reasons; old strict hash delta remains factual
Any unknown/incomplete result rejects; no automatic retry or consumed attempt resurrection
